fountain.streamCaptureFractionSource: Public-health studies assume 32-35% of a fountain stream is drunk when drinking directly (Kenney 2015; IJERPH 2020), based on Coetzee & Bennett 1978.
fountain.typicalStreamSource: Measured school fountains: 9 fl oz in 10.34 s on average (Kenney et al. 2016).
fountain.derivation: 0.33 x 25.7 mL/s = 8.5 mL/s, rounded down to 8 to stay conservative.

calibration.steps: Hold a bottle under the fountain stream for a guided 5 s countdown (or time how long it takes to fill to a known mark), enter the volume collected; rate = 0.33 x collected_mL / seconds, clamped to 4-15 mL/s.

deprecated.reason: No source; cup drinking measures swallowing, while fountain intake is limited by how much of the stream reaches the mouth.

ice.basis: Coca-Cola foodservice crew poster: fill cup with 1/3 ice; a restaurant cost model assumes 30% ice; a 2016 lawsuit alleged a 24 oz Starbucks Venti iced held about 14 oz of liquid (58%), an allegation not a finding; McDonald's bases fountain-drink nutrition on standard fill plus ice.
